# {{NAME}} workspace

Read `_meta.md` in this folder first. Then `ops/STATE.md` (what is live), `ops/AGENDA.md` (what is next), `ops/MEMORY.md` (what was decided). Inside a code repository, follow that repository's own `CLAUDE.md`.

Rules for this workspace:
- Never write a secret into any file here. Secrets come from the vault named in `ops/manifest.json` at run time.
- Work logs go to `ops/log/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md`. Decisions go to `ops/MEMORY.md`. Parked items go to `ops/AGENDA.md`. Keep `ops/STATE.md` true; overwrite it, do not append.
- The Stop hook commits `ops/` and the session end pushes it. Nothing in `ops/` is ever left uncommitted. Code repositories are never auto-committed.
- `_scratch/` is disposable and ignored. Anything else you create outside a repository is a violation of the no-loose-files rule (`cwi doctor`).
